rows.label: Installed Dictionaries
rows.description: Dictionary entries are managed at runtime. The settings tree exposes per-dictionary fields once a dictionary is installed.

rows.label: Enable support for prefix wildcard searches
Frequency sorting dictionary
rows.description: Sort results using a frequency dictionary.

rows.label: Scan modifier key
rows.description: Hold a key while moving the cursor to scan text.

rows.label: Configure advanced scanning inputs...
rows.description: Scanning inputs are used to define when text scanning should occur.

rows.label: Scan delay (in ms)
rows.description: Change the delay before scanning occurs when no modifier key is required.

rows.label: Scan without mouse move
rows.description: Allow scanning words under the pointer without the pointer being in motion.

rows.label: Select matched text
rows.description: Highlight the text that was looked up.

rows.label: Layout-aware scanning
rows.description: Use webpage styling information to determine where line breaks are likely to be.

rows.label: Deep content scanning
rows.description: Enable scanning text that is covered by other layers.

rows.label: Normalize CSS zoom
rows.description: Correct the pointer location on webpages where CSS zoom is used.

rows.label: Wildcard scanning
rows.description: Enable suffix wildcard when looking up scanned webpage text.

rows.label: Text scan length
rows.description: Change how many characters are read when scanning for terms.

rows.label: Allow scanning search page content
rows.description: Text on the search page can be scanned for definitions, which will open a popup.

rows.label: Allow scanning popup content
rows.description: Text inside of popups can be scanned for definitions, which will open a new popup.

rows.label: Maximum number of child popups
rows.description: Change the limit on the number of popups that may be generated.

rows.label: Auto-hide search popup
rows.description: When an existing popup is present, upon scanning again, hide the existing popup even if no definitions are found when scanning again.

rows.label: Hide popup on cursor exit
rows.description: When the cursor exits the popup, the popup will be hidden.

rows.label: Reduced motion scrolling
rows.description: Scrolls by a configurable height (similar to pagination), reducing animations. Useful on e-readers and e-ink screens.

rows.label: Show iframe popups in the root frame
Theme
rows.description: Adjust the style of Yomitan.

rows.label: Action bar appearance
rows.description: Control when and where the action bar is visible.

rows.label: Custom popup CSS
rows.description: CSS injected into the popup.

rows.label: Custom outer CSS
rows.description: CSS injected into the host page around the popup.

rows.label: Display mode
rows.description: Change the layout of the popup.

rows.label: Scale
rows.description: Control the scaling factor of the popup.

rows.label: Width (in pixels)
rows.description: Control the width of the popup, in pixels.

rows.label: Height (in pixels)
rows.description: Control the height of the popup, in pixels.

rows.label: Horizontal text positioning
rows.description: Change where the popup is positioned relative to horizontal text.

rows.label: Vertical text positioning
rows.description: Change where the popup is positioned relative to vertical text.

rows.label: Horizontal text offset (px)
rows.description: Change the distance the popup is placed relative to horizontal text.

rows.label: Vertical text offset (px)
rows.description: Change the distance the popup is placed relative to vertical text.
